messages:
Caroline: Quick sync — planning DP recruitment + beta gating for the Private/Dedicated early access. Need to finalize success criteria, cohort size, and feedback cadence by EOD Friday. Who can own which pieces?
Jonah: I can own the intake screener + invite copy. thinking cohort cap 8 to start, unless we want a smaller, high-touch cohort.
Priya: +1 on owning cohort segmentation. Suggest split 4 "high-SLA" partners + 4 exploratory. smaller makes it easier to iterate on rollout.
Marco: For quantitative success criteria propose: 
- P95 latency <= 120ms under our target load
- end-to-end error rate < 0.5% (5xx + model failures)
- 90% of requests served from pinned model variant when requested
Also add acceptance: partner completes integration tests and basic perf checklist.
Ana: Add qualitative metrics: partner sentiment score (weekly quick NPS >= 7), and all blocker bugs P0/P1 triaged within 48h.
Leah: Feedback loop idea: weekly asynchronous report (shared doc + short highlights in #dp-feedback), and biweekly 30m sync with each partner for first 6 weeks. create a unified feedback template.
Caroline: Love it. Draft rollout phases and gating checklist below — please comment/edit.
```
GATE CHECKLIST (must pass to move to next phase):
- [ ] Screening: signed NDA + intake answers + product fit confirmed
- [ ] Integration: baseline integration tests pass (auth, routing, basic prompts)
- [ ] Validation: 2-week smoke run hitting latency & error SLOs
- [ ] Feedback loop: 2 consecutive weeks of partner reports + one sync call
- [ ] Launch approval: engineering + product + CS sign-off
```
Marco: For incentives — recommend 6 months of free Dedicated credits + one co-marketing case study (if partner opts in). keeps partners engaged.
Priya: Also propose a small implementation bonus ($2k equivalent in credits) for teams that complete integration within 2 weeks. reduces drag.
Jonah: I'll draft the intake form and share in this thread by EOD today. can someone volunteer to set up the #dp-feedback channel + doc template?
Leah: I can create the channel and baseline template. will add the weekly report section and a timestamped action tracker.
survey-bot: Poll created — "Preferred cohort size" options: 4 / 6 / 8. Vote by EOD.
Caroline: OK owners: Jonah (intake + invite), Priya (segmentation + incentives), Leah (feedback channel + template), Marco (success metrics + gating). I'll coordinate outreach and legal NDA. Thanks all — we'll reconvene Wed 10am to finalize targets. :thumbsup:
